The answer is Phil Belanger, WECA's first chairman. I have the source: the Boing Boing post "WiFi isn't short for 'Wireless Fidelity'" by Cory Doctorow, November 8, 2005, and the Wi-Fi Alliance's own page confirming "Phil Belanger, WECA's first chairman."

I should give a brief answer and cite URLs.

content.text:
**Phil Belanger（菲尔·贝朗热）**

依据：Boing Boing 2005 年 11 月 8 日的文章《WiFi isn't short for "Wireless Fidelity"》收录了他的来信，其中自述是 Wireless Ethernet Compatibility Alliance（WECA，即后来的 Wi-Fi Alliance）创始成员，主持了 "Wi-Fi" 这一名称的选定；Wi-Fi Alliance 官网也确认他是 "WECA's first chairman"。

- https://web.archive.org/web/20161212211011/http://boingboing.net/2005/11/08/wifi-isnt-short-for.html
- https://www.wi-fi.org/zh-hant/beacon/jeff-abramowitz/wi-fi-alliance-then-and-now
